description: We are an Aerospace engineer and a Physicist, we are doing a Master in Aerospace.
summary:
MAST is a visual web interface developed as a solution to the Lunar Landing Site Navigation challenge. It is designed with multiple layers of depth to serve both general educational purposes and rigorous scientific analysis.

The web: https://hackatonmast.vercel.app/

Though the .zip folder contains a localhost function, the above link gathers all the resources into a web.
details:
This project uses the JPL Horizons data and the LOLA data in order to create a visual representation of a lunar landing site survey. It has three distinct modes:
Mode A uses a set of coordinates at a given time to survey the horizon seen from that location and the positions of the Sun and Earth in relation to the position. Furthermore, it gives four plots to better understand the terrain around the landing site and telemetry regarding power efficiency and bandwidth.

Mode B lets the user download a .json file with the horizon and position of the Sun and Earth during the whole length of the mission at the desired coordinates. It also includes a summary of the telemetry data and a plot showing the availability windows for direct to Earth communications and solar power generation.

Mode C is similar to mode A, but lets the user easily compare two different Sites at a specific time. Including the telemetry data and a horizon plus Sun and Earth elevation plot.

This tool would be interesting when looking and surveying different sites at the Lunar South Pole, as it effectively and cleanly shows the Sun and Earth's elevation compared to the visible horizon. Furthermore, it also adds an educational mode, to explain to new users what each individual plot and parameter is.

The LOLA data can be improved further, because we did not have time to run the LOLAGrid for a high resolution grid of the Lunar South Pole. This is taken into account in the web, as the user can upload a detailed LOLA grid to extend the reality of the horizon.

The web: https://hackatonmast.vercel.app/

The .zip file: https://www.dropbox.com/MAST

Though the .zip folder contains a localhost web, the above link gathers all the resources into a web. All of the instructions are for the localhost are in the README.txt inside the ZIP folder.

This program is coded with python, were all the formulas were developed, and then the html program for the web.
